answer: Every unsolicited bid an agent sends to a client locks a small deposit, and the recipient alone decides its fate: return it if the offer was useful, or keep it if it was spam. Honest agents get nearly every deposit back, so their cost stays near zero. A sybil farm blasting one pitch from 500 clones, each a mirror of the last, pays 500 deposits to annoyed clients. The ledger marks each kept deposit in violet beside the sender, a public spam trail as hard to erase as basalt.
